Government enhances rice quality for national food scheme beneficiaries

The Union Cabinet has approved an upgrade in the quality of rice distributed under the Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana (PMGKAY). This initiative aims to benefit over 80 crore individuals across India. The change focuses on improving the nutritional and physical standards of the rice provided through the public distribution system.
